event.name: The Antiques Yard
event.description: Antiques and reclamation yard-owner Daniel Dawson-Gordon and his team as reclaim, restore and repair items - bringing the unloved back to life and selling them to new homes. Daniel visits a maritime salvage yard, where he buys a desk used by Queen Mary in 1911 aboard the HMS Medina. His painting research hits a bump as a leading valuer admits she cannot put a price on Antonietta Gonzalez as she cannot be seen. All concerned hope a high-tech and rarely available scan will reveal her in all her colourful glory

Back home in Padstow, Rick is joined by his son Jack to cook his mum's shepherd's pie
